description: This file defines React components for a code display window with customizable styling and UI elements, including a wrapper, side panels, and control buttons for a code window UI.

methods.name: MenuBtn
methods.description: A functional React component rendering a styled clickable circle button, used as a menu or control button in the code window UI.

methods.name: WindowWrapper
methods.description: A React component that provides a grid layout container for wrapping content, typically used as the outer wrapper for a code panel.

methods.name: WindowL
methods.description: A React component for the left panel of the code window, displaying code content with styling.

methods.name: WindowR
methods.description: A React component for the right panel of the code window, with background and border styling for code display.

methods.name: CodeWindow
methods.description: Main React component combining layout and styling to render a styled code display box with line numbering and control buttons.
